@@ -1,5 +1,19 @@
 name: Publish vendor artifacts
 
+# The build is split into two producer jobs and a release job.
+#
+# `parser` and `rewrite` are separate because most of the work is genuinely
+# independent: only rewrite-flix needs the parser jar, while the other seven
+# OpenRewrite modules do not, so they build on a second runner instead of
+# queueing behind the Flix assembly. Splitting also makes failure attribution
+# and re-runs land where the problem is -- a rewrite-side test failure re-runs
+# the rewrite job rather than a four-minute Flix build.
+#
+# They still share one version and one tag. Separate release cadences would be
+# the logical end state, but rewrite-flix does not yet pin a published parser
+# artifact, so the shared tag is currently the only thing guaranteeing the two
+# halves match.
+
 on:
   workflow_dispatch:
     inputs:

+      - name: Supply the parser jar to rewrite-flix
